lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dust motes dance in the hallway light
Old secrets rest in the shadows deep
A ghost of a memory takes flight
In the hollow space where promises sleep
[Pre-Chorus]
The clock ticks steady against the wall
Waiting for the heavy rain to fall
[Chorus]
Break the silence, let the colors fly
Hold the truth beneath a heavy sky
Every whisper turns into a roar
Searching for the peace I was looking for
[Verse]
The kettle hums a low, steady tune
The floorboards creak beneath my feet
I chase the fading light of the moon
Where the past and present finally meet
[Pre-Chorus]
The shadows stretch across the floor
I don't have to hide anymore
[Chorus]
Break the silence, let the colors fly
Hold the truth beneath a heavy sky
Every whisper turns into a roar
Searching for the peace I was looking for
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The walls are closing in so tight
I am reaching for the morning light
[Chorus]
Break the silence, let the colors fly
Hold the truth beneath a heavy sky
Every whisper turns into a roar
Searching for the peace I was looking for
[Outro]
